questions.title: Negative Slice Outputs
questions.description:
The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

vals = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
print(vals[-2:])
print(vals[1:-1])

questions.title: Enumerate with Start
questions.description:
The snippet prints three lines. What are they?

fruits = ["kiwi", "fig", "plum"]
for i, fruit in enumerate(fruits, start=1):
    print(i, fruit)

questions.title: Zip Pair Printing
questions.description:
The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

names = ["ana", "bob"]
scores = [80, 90]
for name, score in zip(names, scores):
    print(name, score)
questions.Option4: ana 80, then bob 90, then ana 90, then bob 80
questions.codesnippet:
names = ["ana", "bob"]
scores = [80, 90]
for name, score in zip(names, scores):
    print(name, score)

questions.title: Function Mutates Caller List
questions.description:
The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

def add_tag(items):
    items.append("x")
    return items

a = [1, 2]
b = add_tag(a)
print(a)
print(b is a)
questions.codesnippet:
def add_tag(items):
    items.append("x")
    return items

a = [1, 2]
b = add_tag(a)
print(a)
print(b is a)

questions.title: Tuple Holding a Mutable List
questions.description:
The tuple itself is immutable, but elements it holds may still be mutable. The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

t = (1, [2, 3])
t[1].append(4)
print(t)
print(len(t))
questions.Option1: A TypeError is raised before anything prints

questions.title: Slice Assignment Resizes
questions.description:
Slice assignment can change a list's length. The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
nums[1:3] = [20, 30, 40]
print(nums)
print(len(nums))

questions.title: Swap and Star Printing
questions.description:
The snippet prints two lines. What are they?

a, b = 3, 7
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)
print(*[10, 20, 30], sep="-")
questions.codesnippet:
a, b = 3, 7
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)
print(*[10, 20, 30], sep="-")
